# Atria Health and Research Institute

> > Atria is a preventive medicine and longevity science organization offering concierge healthcare, clinical research, and community health programs across multiple U.S. locations.

Atria Health and Research Institute combines clinical practice with medical research focused on preventive medicine, precision medicine, and longevity science. The organization operates concierge medical practices in New York and Palm Beach, maintains a dedicated research institute, and runs public health initiatives for community wellness and health equity.
